about: The experiment register and the playbook (from 2026-10-16), read by `node ig.mjs review`. Each experiment has its one change, its pass mark as numbers and its outcomes. A proven experiment does not become a rule: it joins the playbook as a 'boost' (ideas with it score higher), a 'format' (at most its share of the reels), a 'slot' (a share of the slots, like the English slot) or a 'default' (the normal choice, which a reel may break with a reason). The playbook guides the two bet slots in every three only; experiment slots and the wild card ignore it. Proven entries are re-checked every 60 days or 20 reels and go back to the queue when they stop beating the other reels. A failed experiment retires for 90 days and may come back once for a re-test. `node ig.mjs review --apply` (run by the create-reel hook) applies all of this, writes the playbook into the marked blocks of CLAUDE.md and VIDEOS.md, and logs every change in results/experiment-log.md. Claude keeps the queue at 3 open experiments or more, adds a try when a reel tests an experiment, and lists in a reel's script.json (`playbook`) the proven entries it used.

experiments.name: Visible magic
experiments.change: A tool whose result is a before and after the eye sees in one second

tries.note: a selfie becomes a professional photo (Gemini)

CONFIRM.text: A visible before and after (question 9) counts double in the idea score. An idea without one can still win.

DISCARD.text: Question 9 counts like the other questions.

experiments.name: Funny
experiments.change: A comedy skit with the cast; the AI trick is the punchline

CONFIRM.text: A funny skit with the cast, with the AI trick as the punchline (feeling: funny).

DISCARD.text: No comedy skits until its re-test.

experiments.name: Short loop
experiments.change: Under 15 seconds, the end runs into the start, no follow card

CONFIRM.text: A short loop under 15 seconds, built from films/_template-short/.

DISCARD.text: No short loops until its re-test; reels keep the full story structure.

experiments.name: Quiz
experiments.change: The viewer answers a question in the comments

CONFIRM.text: A reel that ends with a question the viewer answers in the comments (a quiz).

DISCARD.text: No quiz endings until its re-test.

experiments.name: My own risk
experiments.change: A SCAM reel about the viewer's own risk, sent to a friend, not to parents

tries.note: a fake job offer asks a training fee; the sequel to #11; sent to a friend who is job hunting

CONFIRM.text: A SCAM idea about the viewer's own risk, sent to a friend of the viewer's age, scores one point higher.

DISCARD.text: Own-risk SCAM ideas get no extra point.

experiments.name: Fast news
experiments.change: An AI launch that matters to students, made within 24 hours

CONFIRM.text: A big AI launch that matters to students may jump the lane plan: such an idea is offered first, made within 24 hours.

DISCARD.text: News gets no priority: a news reel waits for its lane.

experiments.name: My own voice
experiments.change: I record the voice instead of the AI voice (last in the queue: 'maybe later')
experiments.pass: Followers per 1,000 reach on the reel's days above the T2 level; Claude judges it at the full review

CONFIRM.text: My recorded voice is the default (node vo.mjs <dir> --own); a reel may use the synthesized voice with a reason.

experiments.name: Posting time
experiments.change: Post at 7 to 8:30 PM India time instead of 10:30 PM to midnight

CONFIRM.text: Default posting time: 7 to 8:30 PM India time.

REVERSE.text: Default posting time: 10:30 PM to midnight India time.

DISCARD.text: Posting time makes no clear difference: post when it suits me.

experiments.name: AI जुगाड़ series
experiments.change: Series number on cover and title, a follow line after the first payoff, the next number on the end card

CONFIRM.text: TOOL reels and AI reels with a trick are in the AI जुगाड़ series by default (number in the title, cover badge, follow line after the first payoff, the next number on the end card).

DISCARD.text: Drop the AI जुगाड़ series until its re-test; Claude proposes another reason to follow as a new experiment.

experiments.name: English reels
experiments.change: One reel in five in very easy US English, judged by value (tier-1 views x 10 + other views)

MORE.text: Two reels in every five are offered in English (both TOOL slots after the first).

KEEP.text: One reel in every five is offered in English (the TOOL slot after SCAM).

DISCARD.text: No English slot on this account until its re-test. (A separate English account is my choice.)
